body: Four tests in skywaved/src/workdir/changes.rs (changes_are_capped_by_path_and_counted and three siblings) build 300-file trees and run under SNAPSHOT_DEADLINE (15 s). On the Pi with tests in parallel each takes >15 s and fails with Failed { reason: "timed out" }; alone 7 s, serially all pass. CLAUDE.md: decide outcomes from definitive signals, not timeouts. Give the tests a deadline they can't hit, or smaller trees.
title: Make workdir::changes cap tests independent of the snapshot deadline
